thread:
Sofia M: Hi team — took a Grab from Changi to client site on 2026-03-18 for SGD 28.50. Corporate card declined so I paid on personal. Driver lost e-receipt; app shows only pending charge. Uploaded bank screenshot and a blurry driver note: https://uploads.mock/receipts/1898765432.zip

Lina (Finance): Reimbursable if we have bank txn line + alternate proof. Please paste the bank description exactly and attach statement showing last 4.

Sofia M: Bank shows: "GRAB*GRABPAY 03/18 SGP 28.50". Attached bank_statement.png and driver_note.jpg. I also opened ticket with Grab #G-55412 — they confirmed the payment id but may take 48-72h for the receipt.

expense-bot: :warning: Attachment missing: bank_statement.png. Please attach the full card statement screenshot (showing last 4 digits).

Sofia M: Uploaded bank_statement.png now.

Lina (Finance): OK. Per policy, taxi/rideshare with bank txn + app ticket qualifies as alternate proof when official merchant invoice missing. We need manager approval for > SGD 25 without merchant invoice. @Raj please approve. Code as TRAVEL:LOCAL.

Raj (Manager): Approved. Confirming business purpose and client site travel.

Tom (Card Ops): Note: corp card declines for quick rides in APAC often due to MCC or AVS checks. DM me last 4 + timestamp and Ill whitelist the merchant or issue a travel virtual card.

Lina (Finance): Which payout do you prefer Sofia, payroll or ACH? If ACH, DM masked routing. We'll process SGD 28.50 in next ACH run.

Sofia M: ACH preferred. DMing masked routing ****6789. Thanks!

expense-bot: :white_check_mark: Expense submitted to payroll queue. Status: manager-approved -> queued for ACH run.

Lina (Finance): Closing once payment posts. If Grab provides a formal receipt later, upload it and we'll attach to the record.
